mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies with a temperature of 88 degrees, though the heat index makes it feel like 99 degrees near the Verona Public Library.

In city news, the Senior Center is undergoing flooring upgrades starting September 1, leading to modified hours, and residents should note that all city facilities will be closed for Labor Day on September 7.

We have a busy couple of days ahead. Today you can catch trivia at Hop Haus or Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park or enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's.
In our weekly police recap, we noted that on August 25, officers successfully used an AED to save a man experiencing a medical emergency in the 1100 block of Enterprise Drive.
Today at Culver's, enjoy the delicious Chocolate Heath Crunch. The store is currently open and will be serving up scoops until 10:00 PM tonight.
